name: Classify official native APPOINT after a real turn without assuming UI qualification

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and type(ExposedMembers.JAC_LeaderPersonaNativeRead)=='function'

steps.code: local leader='LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO'; local row=assert(GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas[leader]); local def=assert(GameInfo.Governors[row.GovernorType]); assert(def.TraitType=='TRAIT_JAC_TEST_ASHINA_JOINED'); local ids=PlayerManager.GetAliveMajorIDs(); assert(#ids==22,'requires 22 living major players'); local seen={}; local n=0; for _,id in ipairs(ids) do assert(not seen[id],'duplicate player'); seen[id]=true; local gov=assert(Players[id]:GetGovernors()); local persons=0; for person in GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas() do local d=assert(GameInfo.Governors[person.GovernorType]); assert(not gov:CanEverAppointGovernor(d.Hash),'unjoined candidate open: '..id..'/'..person.LeaderType); n=n+1; persons=persons+1 end; assert(persons==22,'requires 22 persons per player') end; assert(n==484); assert(not Players[0]:GetGovernors():HasGovernor(def.Hash)); return 'all 484 native player/person pairs closed before joining'
UI.RequestPlayerOperation(Game.GetLocalPlayer(),PlayerOperations.EXECUTE_SCRIPT,{OnStart='JAC_TestPersonaTraitGrantPrepare'}); return 'real Join, title reservation and owner modifier requested'

local leader='LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO'; local receipt=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_TEST_PERSONA_TRAIT_GRANT_RECEIPT')); local row=assert(GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas[leader]); local def=assert(GameInfo.Governors[row.GovernorType]); local g=assert(Players[0]:GetGovernors()); assert(receipt.owner==0 and receipt.source==2 and receipt.leader==leader); assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_PERSONA_'..leader..'_OWNER')==0 and Game:GetProperty('JAC_PERSONA_'..leader..'_STATE')=='EVOLVING'); assert(g:GetGovernorPointsSpent()==receipt.beforeSpent and receipt.total-receipt.spent>=1); return 'attached receipt; CanEver='..tostring(g:CanEverAppointGovernor(def.Hash))..'; total='..receipt.total..'; spent='..receipt.spent

local leader='LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO'; local row=assert(GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas[leader]); local def=assert(GameInfo.Governors[row.GovernorType]); local ids=PlayerManager.GetAliveMajorIDs(); assert(#ids==22,'requires 22 living major players'); local seen={}; local n=0; for _,id in ipairs(ids) do assert(not seen[id],'duplicate player'); seen[id]=true; local gov=assert(Players[id]:GetGovernors()); local persons=0; for person in GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas() do local d=assert(GameInfo.Governors[person.GovernorType]); local allowed=gov:CanEverAppointGovernor(d.Hash); assert(((id==0 and person.LeaderType==leader) or not allowed),'wrong native eligibility: '..id..'/'..person.LeaderType); n=n+1; persons=persons+1 end; assert(persons==22,'requires 22 persons per player') end; assert(n==484); local g=Players[0]:GetGovernors(); assert(not g:HasGovernor(def.Hash)); local l='LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO'; local r=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_TEST_PERSONA_TRAIT_GRANT_RECEIPT')); local d=GameInfo.Governors[GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas[l].GovernorType]; local g=Players[0]:GetGovernors(); assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_PERSONA_'..l..'_OWNER')==0 and Game:GetProperty('JAC_PERSONA_'..l..'_STATE')=='EVOLVING'); assert(g:GetGovernorPointsSpent()==r.beforeSpent and not g:HasGovernor(d.Hash)); return 'after real turn UI CanEver='..tostring(g:CanEverAppointGovernor(d.Hash))

local d=GameInfo.Governors[GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas['LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO'].GovernorType]; UI.RequestPlayerOperation(0,PlayerOperations.APPOINT_GOVERNOR,{[PlayerOperations.PARAM_GOVERNOR_TYPE]=d.Index}); return 'official APPOINT sent once for the real reserved person'
UI.RequestPlayerOperation(0,PlayerOperations.EXECUTE_SCRIPT,{OnStart='JAC_TestPersonaTraitGrantObserve'}); return 'official account observation requested after the second real turn'

local l='LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO'; local r=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_TEST_PERSONA_TRAIT_GRANT_RECEIPT')); local o=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_TEST_PERSONA_TRAIT_GRANT_OBSERVATION')); local row=GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas[l]; local d=GameInfo.Governors[row.GovernorType]; local g=Players[0]:GetGovernors(); assert(o.owner==0 and o.turn==Game.GetCurrentGameTurn() and o.turn>=r.preparedTurn+2 and o.spent==g:GetGovernorPointsSpent() and o.total==g:GetGovernorPoints()); local appointed=g:HasGovernor(d.Hash); if appointed then assert(o.spent==r.beforeSpent+1 and g:GetGovernor(d.Hash):HasPromotion(GameInfo.GovernorPromotions[row.BasePromotionType].Hash),'native appointment and official account differ'); return 'NATIVE_REQUEST_ACCEPTED; UI CanEver='..tostring(g:CanEverAppointGovernor(d.Hash)) else assert(o.spent==r.beforeSpent,'points spent without native Governor'); return 'NATIVE_REQUEST_REFUSED; UI CanEver='..tostring(g:CanEverAppointGovernor(d.Hash)) end
